summary: Backend regression passed all 7 tests. Mobile preview loaded without red-screen/runtime errors; investigator and admin role-switch/login dashboards, logout, and victim scan rendered successfully.
action_items: Add explicit regression assertions for GET /api/cases with investigator/admin bearer tokens and denial for victim/unauthenticated callers.
critical_code_review_comments: Scan cases are persisted globally and POST /api/scan is intentionally unauthenticated; confirm this matches the intended victim privacy/reporting model before production.
ACTIVE_TOKENS is process-memory demo auth and has no expiry/revocation; acceptable for MVP demo only.

success_rate.frontend: 100% core flows (role switch, 3 logins, logout, scan, dashboard rendering)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created; scans created test cases through the existing scan API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The scan classification is rendered as 'Known/Reported Phishing' because React Native textTransform capitalizes the API's lowercase classification. Live feed and AI explanation fallbacks remain MOCKED when unavailable/configuration is absent.
rca_of_issue: The first UI script assertion expected lowercase API classification text, while the UI applies textTransform: capitalize. Screenshot confirmed correct scan output; no application failure was found.
